message.content: {"version":"1","outfits":[{"id":"office_creative_neat","caption":"Neat camel cardigan over fitted brown trousers","pole":"filter_and_rank","items":["#202·20","#69·00","#542·33","#147·03","#309·41","#84·03"],"day":"For the creative office in autumn, this neat outfit uses a fitted double-breasted blazer to structure the silhouette without adding bulk, paired with high-waisted trousers that maintain a vertical line from waist to ankle. The camel turtleneck top keeps the neckline quiet and elongated for close-up viewing, while the brown loafers ground the look in smart casual formality suitable for walking on office grounds. The beige crossbody bag matches the jacket's warmth without competing, and the dark grey belt accents the waist subtly against the neutral palette.","deliberate":[{"item":"#542·33","why":"Chosen as outerwear to provide a fitted layer that defines the shoulders without overwhelming the 'O' shape; its double-breasted cut adds structure while the camel color stays within the dominant role of the scheme.","finding":"The item fits the day's neat formality band and offers a vertical anchor."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#469·40","why":"A belt is not strictly necessary on a fitted double-breasted blazer which already defines the waistline; adding one here would clutter the 'quiet' middle zone requested for her belly area, contradicting the goal to keep zones quiet."},{"action":"declined","item":"#253·34","why":"The scarf is omitted in favor of a simple look where the jacket collar suffices for warmth and style; adding a scarf would disrupt the clean lines preferred for the 'neat' occasion formality."}]}},{"id":"tonal_column_camel","caption":"Tone-on-tone camel sweater with wide beige pants","pole":"tonal_column","items":["#247·33","#36·39","#50·34","#144·34","#309·41","#84·03"],"day":"This outfit leans into the tonal scheme by repeating the camel family in a relaxed sweater and wide beige trousers, creating a long, unbroken vertical line that flatters her 'O' shape and hides any width at the waist. The hem of the midi skirt falls safely below the knee for movement during the day, while the loafers provide a solid accent in brown to balance the warm neutrals. The beige bag echoes the trousers perfectly, keeping the outfit calm and unified without loud accents that might draw attention to unwanted zones.","deliberate":[{"item":"#36·39","why":"Selected for its wide cut which creates a straight line from hip to ankle, essential for her 'O' shape to guide the eye vertically; the beige color matches the trousers to extend the vertical axis."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#204·27","why":"The patterned trouser would introduce unnecessary noise into the tonal column concept; sticking to solid beige and camel maintains the calm, unified look required for the 'neat' occasion formality."}]}},{"id":"anchor_first_chocolate_blouse","caption":"Chocolate blouse with wide chocolate jeans","pole":"anchor_first","items":["#18·01","#20·35","#54·34","#91·41","#309·41","#84·03"],"day":"Using the bold chocolate blouse as the anchor, this outfit creates a high-contrast look against the black and brown neutrals that holds interest without overwhelming her frame. The wide-leg jeans in dark chocolate extend the leg line and hide any bulk at the hips or waist, while the silver loafers add a metallic accent to break up the deep tones near the face. The small crossbody bag keeps the silhouette streamlined for moving through an office environment, and the dark grey belt adds a subtle structural element without clinging to the middle.","deliberate":[{"item":"#18·01","why":"The blouse pattern and color serve as the primary accent and focal point; its 'boho' register is acceptable here because it acts as the loud witness needed for her goal of expressiveness within the neat occasion band."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#257·28","why":"A headband is omitted as the blouse collar provides enough visual interest near the ears and neck; adding a headpiece would over-stylize the face area which should remain quiet."}]}},{"id":"ease_the_knot_beige_suit","caption":"Beige suit with wide palazzo pants for comfort","pole":"ease_the_knot","items":["#206·12","#364·09","#50·34","#309·41","#84·03"],"day":"This outfit addresses the 'knot' at the ankle by pairing the fitted vest with wide palazzo trousers that flare gently, creating an elegant anchor point without restricting movement during long days. The camel color of the suit unifies the top and bottom, while the beige loafers echo the shoes' role to keep the look cohesive. The brown bag adds a small pop of color that doesn't compete with the main palette, and the grey belt subtly defines the waist without tightening it.","deliberate":[{"item":"#364·09","why":"Selected as outerwear (vest) to layer over the blouse; its fitted cut scores high on her body shape by defining the shoulders without adding volume to the upper body, helping balance the 'O' shape."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#253·34","why":"The scarf is not needed as the suit jacket already provides a finished collar; omitting it prevents clutter around the neck which is a key zone for seated viewing."}]}},{"id":"free_brown_shoes_anchor","caption":"Brown leather shoes anchoring a neutral camel look","pole":"free","items":["#54·34","#36·39","#206·12","#309·41","#84·03","#227·33"],"day":"This outfit uses the brown loafers as the anchor, pairing them with wide beige trousers and a camel knit sweater to create a classic, understated look that works well for office walking. The midi-length trousers elongate the leg line, while the relaxed fit of the sweater hides any mid-section width. The crossbody bag matches the shoes in tone, keeping the lower half unified, and the grey belt adds a neutral strip across the waist to break up the vertical mass.","deliberate":[{"item":"#227·33","why":"The black long sleeve provides a sharp contrast at the upper body which helps define the shoulders against the 'O' shape; its dark color acts as a counterweight to the light camel tones below."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#509·28","why":"A large kerchief is too voluminous for this neat occasion; it would add unwanted volume to the upper body where we want to keep the silhouette quiet and streamlined."}]}},{"id":"free_charcoal_suit_mix","caption":"Charcoal blazer with wide beige trousers mix","pole":"free","items":["#11·28","#36·39","#50·34","#309·41","#84·03","#171·40"],"day":"Mixing the dark charcoal blazer with wide beige trousers creates a sophisticated contrast that elongates the figure and draws the eye vertically. The relaxed knit sweater underneath adds softness to the structured jacket, balancing the 'O' shape by softening the shoulder line without adding bulk. The brown loafers ground the outfit in earth tones, while the grey belt subtly highlights the natural waist. This combination fits the neat occasion formality perfectly.","deliberate":[{"item":"#171·40","why":"The beige gilet worn under the blazer adds a layer of warmth without adding bulk; its neutral color blends seamlessly with the trousers to extend the vertical line."}],"done":[{"action":"declined","item":"#509·28","why":"A large kerchief is omitted to keep the neck area clean and focused on the face; a scarf would add too much volume around the ears and chin."}]}},{"id":"free_olive_green_accent","caption":"Olive green scarf with camel knit sweater","pole":"free","items":["#247·33","#36·39","#50·34","#309·41","#84·03","#542·33"],"day":"This outfit introduces a splash of olive green through a large scarf, providing the only color accent in an otherwise neutral camel and beige palette.
